title: Orchard and Garden
author: August Hartwell
blurb: Coral Villalobos, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
